# P6 test fixtures

**Original** files (CC0-1.0), created for the tests; no third-party set. The root `fixtures/` folder is part of the frozen v1.0 specification (`DOSSIER_MANIFEST.json`): fixtures added after v1.0 live here.

- `notice-sync-8.mpd`: 8 3001 bricks, 2 LDraw steps. The tests map them to 4 steps of a synthetic instruction booklet, with 2 steps on the same page, a callout box, and a "2x" multiplier, to reproduce the shape measured on 31040 (11 LDraw steps versus 21 official steps).
- `p8-trio.mpd` (P8): a main model of 4 bricks (including a submodel) and a second "tower" model (3 bricks) that nothing in the file uses, for detecting alternative builds of the same MPD.
- OMR pages and Rebrickable responses of the P8 tests: **synthetic**, written in the tests (`tests/unit/online-sources.test.ts`, `tests/e2e/add-set.spec.ts`); no real page is recorded.
- `mecanisme-axe.ldr` (connections): a black Technic axle 6 (3706) passes through three orange cross blocks (6536) and two half bushings (32123a); two pins (2780) into two orange bricks with a hole (6541), a plate (3023) on one of them. Traps: a block aligned beyond the end of the axle, a holed brick aligned without a pin, a 4519 axle in a 3001 brick without a hole, a 3958 plate that hides the mechanism without being fitted onto it. Real LDraw references, original positions.
- `pente-inversee-bloc.ldr` (beige block of 31039): a 6 × 1 inverted curved slope (41763) on a 2 × 4 brick, a 3 × 1 inverted slope (4287) on a hollow stud at the thin end of the curve, a gray 4 × 4 corner plate (2639) straddling the stud of the 4287 and a beige brick with a hole (6541), itself on a 1 × 1 brick. The studs at the end of 41763 and two studs of 4287 are drawn longer than a stud in the LDraw files; the tubes of 41763 stop 0.4 LDU above its edge. Real LDraw references, original positions.
